BLADED.gloss: bearing or characterized by a blade or sword
BLADED.definition: Bearing or characterized by a blade or sword; often used in combination.
BLADED.example: He fought on, broken-bladed but unbowed.

BLADE.gloss: especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole
BLADE.definition: Especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole.

ABLE.gloss: having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something
ABLE.definition: (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something.

DEAL.gloss: act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression
DEAL.definition: Act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression.

LEAD.example: We lead him to our chief.

DEAD.gloss: no longer having or seeming to have or expecting to have life
DEAD.definition: No longer having or seeming to have or expecting to have life.

DALE.definition: An open river valley (in a hilly area).

ADD.definition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of.
ADD.example: We added two students to that dorm room.

BED.gloss: a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
BED.definition: A piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep.
BED.example: He sat on the edge of the bed.

DAD.gloss: an informal term for a father
DAD.definition: An informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk.

LAB.gloss: a workplace for the conduct of scientific research
LAB.definition: A workplace for the conduct of scientific research.

ALE.gloss: a general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast
ALE.definition: A general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast; in some of the United States an ale is (by law) a brew of more than 4% alcohol by volume.

BALE.gloss: a large bundle bound for storage or transport
BALE.definition: A large bundle bound for storage or transport.

BEAD.gloss: a small ball with a hole through the middle
BEAD.definition: A small ball with a hole through the middle.
